intro: More than 90% of Kyrgyzstan is mountains, mostly the Tian Shan.

chapters.title: Heavenly Mountains
text: The Tian Shan ('Heavenly Mountains') and the Pamir-Alay cover the country. Jengish Chokusu, over 7,400 m, is the highest peak, on the Chinese border.
Huge walnut forests grow at Arslanbob.

chapters.title: Lakes
text: Issyk-Kul is one of the largest mountain lakes in the world and never freezes, despite lying at 1,600 m. Song-Kul is a high summer pasture lake.
